description: Run bounded deterministic trajectories of the proper/improper Jacobson–Matthews 3-cycle Markov chain.

source.title: Generating uniformly distributed random latin squares
source.cross_reference: ETH Zürich Random Algorithms II, FS 2015, Section 2.9.2, Matthew and Jacobson’s Markov chain
source.discovery_only: RosettaGit title index; no implementation or prose used
source.source_license: Copyright belongs to cited authors and publishers. Consulted for algorithm identification and mathematical transition description only; implementation and bounded profile are clean-room.

input.initial_state: A[i,j,k]=1 iff k=(i+j) mod n, otherwise 0
input.choice_order: Proper state: zero cells in lexicographic (i,j,k) order. Improper state: legal (i_prime,j_prime,k_prime) triples in lexicographic order at the unique -1 pivot.
input.choice_range: Each choice must be less than the number of legal moves in the current state; at most 48.

workspace.meaning: Fixed 64-cell tensor, at most 48 move descriptors, and bounded output staging.

contract.proper_move_selection: Choose a zero cell (i,j,k). Find the unique line mates i_prime,j_prime,k_prime whose respective parallel cells contain one.
contract.improper_move_selection: Use the unique -1 cell (i,j,k). Enumerate the eight triples satisfying A[i,j,k_prime]=A[i,j_prime,k]=A[i_prime,j,k]=1.
contract.update: Add one at (i,j,k),(i_prime,j_prime,k),(i_prime,j,k_prime),(i,j_prime,k_prime); subtract one at (i_prime,j,k),(i,j_prime,k),(i,j,k_prime),(i_prime,j_prime,k_prime).
contract.trajectory_model: Every Markov choice is supplied explicitly by the input tape. This package profiles the transition algorithm and does not claim to sample from its stationary distribution.
contract.error_precedence: Validate input pointer, length, dimensions, and every tape choice by replaying the trajectory before checking output pointer and capacity.
contract.complexity: O(step_count*n^3) time and O(n^3) fixed-state storage for n<=4.
